set.body: Purpose: bind the machine-readable validation record to the already published source and oracle commit without a self-referential digest. Acceptance criteria: start only after bd-01M031YWJZB254TEJ94YQ6534Z is published and its live remote SHA is known; from the clean source HEAD run sbt lawsJVM/Test/runMain with eyes4s.laws.GenerateScientificValidationArtifact, library version 0.1.0, that exact 40-character source SHA, and validation/eyes4s-validation-0.1.0.json; require the writer to verify clean tracked/index state, reject untracked source other than the future drift suite, verify committed oracle bytes, and emit canonical JSON atomically with source_state=release and dirty=false; add laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/ScientificValidationFilesSuite.scala in the same artifact commit; stage exactly the validation JSON and drift suite; run the drift suite, laws JVM/Scala.js tests, full testAll/checkBoundaries, and formatting/generated-workflow gates; commit only those two paths; push non-force through the canardlapin identity; prove local HEAD, tracking ref, and live remote SHA equality; record the exact successful hosted Checks URL and separately classify Security. Close hosted CI and the trust epic only after this final hosted proof.
